title: NFL, Packers decline comment on latest statement from Josh Jacobs

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: NFL, Packers decline comment on latest statement from Josh Jacobs
sources.description: On Sunday afternoon, Josh Jacobs's lawyers issued a lengthy and detailed statement responding to the additional allegations of violence contained in documents released by local police on Friday, in connection with the battery charge to which Jacobs previously pleaded no contest.
